name: 83 - API - Queue Outbound Message - Corrected V2

parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS mobile,
        $3::TEXT AS channel,
        $4::TEXT AS purpose,
        $5::TEXT AS message_type,
        NULLIF($6::TEXT, '') AS template_code,
        $7::TEXT AS language,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS subject,
        $9::TEXT AS message_text,
        $10::JSONB AS payload,
        NULLIF($11::TEXT, '') AS related_entity_type,
        NULLIF($12::BIGINT, 0) AS related_entity_id,
        NULLIF($13::TEXT, '') AS request_reference,
        $14::TEXT AS idempotency_key,
        $15::INTEGER AS priority,
        $16::TIMESTAMPTZ AS scheduled_at,
        $17::INTEGER AS max_attempts,
        NULLIF($18::BIGINT, 0) AS permission_check_id,
        $19::TEXT AS permission_decision
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        request.*
    FROM request_data request
    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE
    INNER JOIN patients patient
        ON patient.clinic_id = clinic.id
       AND patient.mobile = request.mobile
    LIMIT 1
),

inserted_message AS (
    INSERT INTO outbound_messages (
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        permission_check_id,
        channel,
        purpose,
        message_type,
        template_code,
        language,
        recipient,
        subject,
        message_text,
        payload,
        related_entity_type,
        related_entity_id,
        request_reference,
        idempotency_key,
        priority,
        status,
        scheduled_at,
        next_attempt_at,
        max_attempts
    )
    SELECT
        context.clinic_id,
        context.patient_id,
        context.permission_check_id,
        context.channel,
        context.purpose,
        context.message_type,
        context.template_code,
        context.language,
        context.mobile,
        context.subject,
        context.message_text,
        context.payload,
        context.related_entity_type,
        context.related_entity_id,
        context.request_reference,
        context.idempotency_key,
        context.priority,
        CASE
            WHEN context.permission_decision = 'deferred'
                THEN 'scheduled'
            WHEN context.scheduled_at > NOW()
                THEN 'scheduled'
            ELSE 'queued'
        END,
        context.scheduled_at,
        CASE
            WHEN context.permission_decision = 'deferred'
                THEN GREATEST(
                    context.scheduled_at,
                    NOW() + INTERVAL '1 hour'
                )
            ELSE context.scheduled_at
        END,
        context.max_attempts
    FROM patient_context context
    WHERE context.permission_decision IN (
        'allowed',
        'deferred'
    )
    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        idempotency_key
    )
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING *
),

existing_message AS (
    SELECT
        message.*
    FROM outbound_messages message
    INNER JOIN patient_context context
        ON message.clinic_id = context.clinic_id
       AND message.idempotency_key =
           context.idempotency_key
    LIMIT 1
),

selected_message AS (
    SELECT
        message.*,
        FALSE AS duplicate_existing
    FROM inserted_message message

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        message.*,
        TRUE AS duplicate_existing
    FROM existing_message message
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM inserted_message
    )

    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN request.permission_decision NOT IN (
            'allowed',
            'deferred'
        )
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM selected_message
        )
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM patient_context
        )
            THEN 'patient_not_found'

        WHEN request.permission_decision = 'blocked'
            THEN 'message_blocked_by_permission'

        WHEN request.permission_decision = 'error'
            THEN 'permission_check_failed'

        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM selected_message
            WHERE duplicate_existing = TRUE
        )
            THEN 'duplicate_message_matched'

        WHEN request.permission_decision = 'deferred'
            THEN 'message_deferred_and_queued'

        ELSE 'outbound_message_queued'
    END AS result,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM selected_message
    ) AS outbound_message_id,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM selected_message
    ) AS message_status,

    (
        SELECT next_attempt_at
        FROM selected_message
    ) AS next_attempt_at,

    (
        SELECT duplicate_existing
        FROM selected_message
    ) AS duplicate_existing,

    request.permission_decision,

    CASE
        WHEN request.permission_decision IN (
            'allowed',
            'deferred'
        )
            THEN 'dispatch_when_due'
        ELSE 'do_not_send'
    END AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## ثبت پیام در صف

قبل از ثبت پیام، Workflow 79 فراخوانی می‌شود.

allowed → queued
deferred → scheduled
blocked → پیام ثبت نمی‌شود

idempotency_key از ثبت تکراری جلوگیری می‌کند.
